!They rush you into act quickly, so you cant think over it too much!_x000D_

 They give you a outside link to a supposedly bitrefill support live chat. They then ask your telegram phone number and ask you to give them the security code so they access you TG account. Then, give you a BTC address and ask you to send 0.035BTC to the Bot rectification address 15WuLpF7XV6K4ArVpmyhiqC494rL7KaMi3_x000D_
_x000D_
My guess is that all connected BTC addresses may very well be of scamming other people._x000D_
_x000D_
the ip 45.55.223.31 was connected to my telegram account until i revoked access._x000D_
This happened exactly at July 23 2020, at 3:47 PM GMT+1 summer time. so that IP at that date and time._x000D_

I did not lost a satoshi, only learned to be even more careful than i usually am...
